You need to query a table named **Products** in an Azure SQL database.  
  
Which three requirements must be satisfied to query the table from the internet? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

choices.label: A
choices.text: You must be assigned the Reader role for the resource group that contains the database.

choices.label: B
choices.text: You must have SELECT access to the Products table.

choices.label: C
choices.text: You must have a user in the database.

choices.label: D
choices.text: You must be assigned the Contributor role for the resource group that contains the database.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Your IP address must be allowed to connect to the database.

definition.explanation:
A client connecting from the internet must have an IP address permitted by the Azure SQL Database firewall. The authenticated principal needs a database user to connect to and be authorized within the database, and it must have `SELECT` permission on the `Products` table (directly or through a role). Azure resource-group Reader and Contributor roles control management-plane access and do not grant permission to query table data.

**Learn more:** [Azure SQL Database IP firewall rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/firewall-configure?view=azuresql) · [Authorize database access with logins and user accounts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-sql/database/logins-create-manage?view=azuresql)

finalExplanation: A client connecting from the internet must have an IP address permitted by the Azure SQL Database firewall. The authenticated principal needs a database user to connect to and be authorized within the database, and it must have `SELECT` permission on the `Products` table (directly or through a role). Azure resource-group Reader and Contributor roles control management-plane access and do not grant permission to query table data.
